source.author: verg
source.text: Optuma torvae forma bovis, cui turpe caput, cui plurima cervix, et crurum tenus a mento palearia pendent; tum longo nullus lateri modus; omnia magna, pes etiam; et camuris hirtae sub cornibus aures.
source.text_original: Optuma torvae / forma bovis, cui turpe caput, cui plurima cervix, / et crurum tenus a mento palearia pendent; / tum longo nullus lateri modus; omnia magna, / pes etiam; et camuris hirtae sub cornibus aures.
source.text_english: The best shape is that of a fierce-looking cow: one with a shapeless head, with a very thick neck, and with dewlaps hanging from the chin down to the legs; then no part of the side is of limited length; everything is large, even the foot; and beneath the curved horns are shaggy ears.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: nunc iam cano capite et arata fronte, ad instar boum pendentibus a mento palearibus frigidus obsistit circum praecordia sanguis.
reuse.text_original: nunc iam cano capite et arata fronte, ad instar boum pendentibus a mento palearibus frigidus obsistit circum praecordia sanguis.
reuse.text_english: Now, with my head already gray and my brow furrowed, with dewlaps hanging from my chin like an ox’s, my blood, cold, stands still around my breast.
